name: AR_CASH_RECEIPT_HISTORY_ALL
description: The AR_CASH_RECEIPT_HISTORY_ALL table contains one row for each step in the life cycle of a receipt. The STATUS column indicates the status for each step: APPROVED for receipts approved for automatic creation and CONFIRMED for receipts confirmed by  customer to be included in automatic receipt creation. Approved and confirmed statuses are valid only for automatically created receipts. Valid statuses for both manually and automatically created receipts include: REMITTED for receipts that were remitted, CLEARED for receipts that were cleared and REVERSED for receipts that were reversed. Receivables posts each row in this table to the General Ledger. Each row debits the account that is represented by the ACCOUNT_CODE_COMBINATION_ID column on the date specified in the GL_DATE column and credits the account on the date specified in the REVERSAL_GL_DATE column, if a date is present in this column. Optionally, each row will also debit (on the date specified in the GL_DATE column) and credit (on the date specified in the REVERSAL_GL_DATE column) the account that is represented by the BANK_CHARGE_ACCOUNT_CCID column for the amount in the FACTOR_DISCOUNT_AMOUNT column, which is the difference between the remitted amount and the cleared amount. The CURRENT_RECORD_FLAG column points to the current row, which is the current status of the cash receipt. The POSTABLE_FLAG column determines if a row can be posted to General Ledger. The primary key for this table is CASH_RECEIPT_HISTORY_ID.

columns.name: CASH_RECEIPT_HISTORY_ID
columns.description: Cash receipt history identifier

columns.name: CASH_RECEIPT_ID
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: One of the following: APPROVED, CONFIRMED, REMITTED, CLEARED, REVERSED

columns.name: TRX_DATE
columns.description: The transaction date when this history row occurs as entered by the user

columns.name: AMOUNT
columns.description: The amount for this step of the life cycle of the receipt.  Most of the amounts will be similar to the original amount of the cash receipt but the cleared amount might be different from the remitted due to any charges the bank took.

columns.name: FIRST_POSTED_RECORD_FLAG
columns.description: This is Y if this is the first row that is posted for this cash receipts; N otherwise.

columns.name: POSTABLE_FLAG
columns.description: This is Y if the row is postable and N otherwise.  It is N for the approved row and N for the REVERSED row.  It is Y for all the other statuses.

columns.name: FACTOR_FLAG
columns.description: This is Y if the status is REMITTED and the cash receipt was factored as specified by the user on the remittance step.

columns.name: GL_DATE
columns.description: The General Ledger Date that is used when debiting the ACCOUNT_CODE_COMBINATION_ID

columns.name: CURRENT_RECORD_FLAG
columns.description: This is Y if this row is the latest step for this cash receipt; it is null otherwise.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: This is a foreign key to the AR_BATCHES table that points to the batch that was used to create this row for this cash receipt.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: This is the account that is either debited or credited (on the GL_DATE and REVERSAL_GL_DATE respectively).

columns.name: REVERSAL_GL_DATE
columns.description: This is the General Ledger Date that is used to credit the ACCOUNT_CODE_COMBINATION_ID.  It also signifies that this row has been reversed.  It could mean that the receipt went on to the next step or reverted one step.

columns.name: REVERSAL_CASH_RECEIPT_HIST_ID
columns.description: This is a unique key that sequences the reversal of this row and is sourced from the same sequence as CASH_RECEIPT_HISTORY_ID.

columns.name: FACTOR_DISCOUNT_AMOUNT
columns.description: This is the amount of the bank charge and/or factor discount taken by the bank at clearance and/or factoring time.

columns.name: BANK_CHARGE_ACCOUNT_CCID
columns.description: This is the account that is debited and/or credited for the FACTOR_DISCOUNT_AMOUNT.

columns.name: POSTING_CONTROL_ID
columns.description: Receivables posting batch identifier; -1 means it was posted by the old posting program (ARXGLP); -2 means it's posted from old rel8 RA; -3 means it's not posted; -4 means it's posted by rel9 RAPOST

columns.name: REVERSAL_POSTING_CONTROL_ID
columns.description: Receivables posting batch identifier; -1 means it was posted by the old posting program (ARXGLP); -2 means it's posted from RA; -3 means it's not posted; this should be null if reversal_gl_date is null.

columns.name: GL_POSTED_DATE
columns.description: Date given when you submit record for General Ledger posting

columns.name: REVERSAL_GL_POSTED_DATE
columns.description: Date given when you submit reversal for General Ledger posting

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ACCTD_AMOUNT
columns.description: This is AMOUNT in the functional currency.

columns.name: ACCTD_FACTOR_DISCOUNT_AMOUNT
columns.description: This is FACTOR_DISCOUNT_AMOUNT in the functional currency.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_DATE
columns.description: Date for which rate selected

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Exchange rate used to convert foreign currency amounts into functional currency

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Used to define multiple currency exchange rates for the same date

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: PROGRAM_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Concurrent Program who column - application id of the program that last updated this row (foreign key to FND_APPLICATION.APPLICATION_ID).

columns.name: PROGRAM_ID
columns.description: Concurrent Program who column - program id of the program that last updated this row (foreign key to FND_CONCURRENT_PROGRAM.CONCURRENT_PROGRAM_ID).

columns.name: PROGRAM_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Concurrent Program who column - date when a program last updated this row).

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: PRV_STAT_CASH_RECEIPT_HIST_ID
columns.description: This column has the CASH_RECEIPT_HISTORY_ID of the record that precedes the current record in status.  Normally, it is the ID of the reversed record.  For rate adjustments, it has the same value as that of the record it reversed/adjusted.

columns.name: CREATED_FROM
columns.description: Populated by code that points to form or program that created this row

columns.name: REVERSAL_CREATED_FROM
columns.description: Populated by code that points to form or program that reversed this row

columns.name: SUBLEDGER_BC_COMPLETE_FLAG
columns.description: Option that indicates whether to interface standard receipt accounting information from General Ledger to Budgetary Control.  This value is passed by Budgetary Control to General Ledger through the accounting information from Receivables.
